carve out a career: Without any help from her family, she managed to carve out a career as a successful fashion designer.
在沒有家人幫助的情況下，她成功開創了成為時裝設計師的事業。
carve a niche: The small bookstore has carved a niche by selling rare comics that big stores do not carry.
這家小書店靠販售大型書店沒有的稀有漫畫，建立了自己的利基。
carve up the territory: After the war, the powerful countries met to carve up the territory among themselves without asking the local people.
戰後，強國們開會瓜分領土，完全沒有詢問當地人民。
carve a turkey: On Thanksgiving, my grandfather always stands at the head of the table to carve a turkey for the whole family.
感恩節時，我祖父總是站在餐桌主位，為全家人切火雞。
cast a vote: Citizens over eighteen can cast a vote in the election, so my sister went to the polling station for the first time.
十八歲以上的公民可以在選舉中投票，所以我姊姊第一次去了投票所。
cast doubt on: New evidence from the scientists has cast doubt on the old theory about how the dinosaurs died.
科學家的新證據使人懷疑關於恐龍如何滅絕的舊理論。
cast a shadow over: The sudden death of the team's coach cast a shadow over the championship celebration.
球隊教練的猝逝讓冠軍慶祝活動蒙上陰影。
cast light on: The old letters found in the attic may cast light on what really happened to the missing family.
在閣樓找到的舊信件可能會闡明那失蹤家庭真正的遭遇。
cast an actor: The director took six months to cast an actor for the main role because he wanted someone unknown.
導演花了六個月為主角選角，因為他想要一位沒沒無聞的演員。
cast a spell: In the story, the evil witch cast a spell on the princess, and she fell asleep for a hundred years.
故事中，邪惡的女巫對公主施魔法，她因此沉睡了一百年。
cater to tourists: Most of the shops on this old street now cater to tourists, selling souvenirs instead of daily goods.
這條老街上大部分的商店現在都在迎合觀光客，賣紀念品而不是日用品。
cater for the party: We hired a local restaurant to cater for the party, so nobody had to cook for fifty guests.
我們請了一家當地餐廳為派對供餐，所以沒人需要為五十位客人做飯。
cater to every taste: The night market has hundreds of food stands that cater to every taste, from spicy noodles to sweet desserts.
夜市有數百個小吃攤，滿足各種口味，從辣麵到甜點都有。
caution against haste: My grandmother always cautions against haste when making big decisions, saying we should sleep on them first.
我祖母在做重大決定時總是告誡勿急躁，說我們應該先睡一晚再想。
caution the driver: The police officer stopped to caution the driver about his speed but decided not to give him a ticket.
警察停下來警告駕駛他的車速，但決定不開罰單。
exercise caution: Hikers should exercise caution on the mountain trail after heavy rain, because the rocks become slippery.
大雨後登山客在山路上應該小心謹慎，因為岩石會變得濕滑。
cease fire: After weeks of fighting, both armies agreed to cease fire so that food could reach the hungry villagers.
經過數週的戰鬥，雙方軍隊同意停火，好讓食物能送到飢餓的村民手中。
cease operations: Because of falling sales, the factory will cease operations next month, and hundreds of workers will lose their jobs.
因為銷售下滑，這間工廠下個月將停止營運，數百名工人將失業。
never cease to amaze: The way my little brother learns new languages so quickly will never cease to amaze me.
我弟弟學新語言學得那麼快，總是令我驚奇。
cease to exist: If we keep destroying their forests, many kinds of animals may cease to exist within fifty years.
如果我們繼續破壞牠們的森林，許多種動物可能在五十年內不復存在。
cement the friendship: The long bike trip around Taiwan helped cement the friendship between the two classmates.
環島的長途單車之旅幫助鞏固了這兩位同學之間的友誼。
cement one's position: Winning the gold medal helped the young swimmer cement her position as the best in Asia.
贏得金牌幫助這位年輕泳將鞏固她亞洲第一的地位。
cement ties: The two cities started a student exchange program to cement ties and help young people understand each other.
兩座城市開辦了學生交換計畫，以強化關係並幫助年輕人互相了解。
center on the issue: The class discussion will center on the issue of whether students should wear school uniforms.
這次的課堂討論將聚焦於學生是否應該穿制服的議題。
be centered around: Life in the small fishing village is centered around the sea, and almost every family owns a boat.
這個小漁村的生活以大海為核心，幾乎每個家庭都有一艘船。
center one's life on: After her son was born, she began to center her life on her family and gave up her job in the city.
兒子出生後，她開始以家庭為生活重心，辭掉了在城市的工作。
be chained to a desk: I don't want to be chained to a desk all day, so I am looking for a job where I can travel.
我不想整天被綁在辦公桌前，所以我在找一份可以到處旅行的工作。
chain smoke: When he is under pressure at work, my uncle tends to chain smoke, which worries the whole family.
我叔叔工作壓力大時，往往會一根接一根抽菸，讓全家人很擔心。
a chain reaction: One car stopped suddenly on the highway, causing a chain reaction in which ten cars crashed.
一輛車在高速公路上突然停下，引起連鎖反應，造成十輛車相撞。
chain of events: Missing the bus started a chain of events that made me late for the most important exam of the year.
錯過公車引發了一連串事件，讓我在一年中最重要的考試遲到。
